{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for missing or invalid customer_age
print("Customer age -1 count:", (sales_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Compute overall conversion rate by channel
overall_conv_rate = sales_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("\nOverall conversion rate by channel:")
print(overall_conv_rate)

# Compute the difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search)
diff = overall_conv_rate['email'] - overall_conv_rate['paid_search']
print(f"\nDifference in conversion rates (email - paid_search): {diff}")"}
